languageModelTools.name: litellm_consult
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Ask a second, independently configured LiteLLM model for its opinion, and get its answer back as text. Reach for it when you want a second opinion before committing to an approach, when you want a plan, a diagnosis or a piece of reasoning sanity-checked, or when a model with different strengths than yours is likely to know better. The other model sees NOTHING of this conversation: send a question that stands on its own, and put the code, errors, or background it needs into 'context'. It only answers - it cannot read files, run commands, or change anything - so act on its answer yourself, and treat it as one opinion rather than as fact.

question.description: The self-contained question to ask. State what you want to know and what a useful answer would look like; the other model sees only this and 'context'.

context.description: Optional background the question depends on: the relevant code, an error message, the constraints, what you already tried. Include what a colleague would need to answer without asking follow-up questions.

languageModelTools.name: litellm_diagnostics
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read the LiteLLM extension's health: connection state, each configured LiteLLM server (label, base URL, state, error classification, served model count, whether a key is configured), configuration problems, the latest error, and optionally the recent log lines with secrets redacted. Call it first when a user reports LiteLLM models missing, failing, or answering empty. Read-only.

includeLogs.description: Include the recent log lines (redacted). Default false.

languageModelTools.name: litellm_configuration
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read the LiteLLM extension's configuration as its dashboard shows it: servers (their settings and where each secret is stored, never the values), every setting with the scope it is configured in, the models each server serves (raw model ID, server label, token limits), hidden provider groups, the OpenRouter catalog status, and usage. Pass sections to read a slice; the whole picture can be large. Read-only.

sections.description: Which sections to return. Default: all.

languageModelTools.name: litellm_inspect_model
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Explain one model's effective capabilities (context window, token limits, tools, vision, reasoning) and request parameters, with the source of each value: the server's report, the OpenRouter catalog, a models.capabilities or models.parameters record, or the built-in floor. Use it before changing a model record. Read-only.

server.description: The servers entry label, from litellm_configuration.

model.description: The raw model ID as the server names it, from litellm_configuration.

languageModelTools.name: litellm_search_catalog
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Search the bundled OpenRouter model catalog by name or ID, to find a model's published context window or its catalog ID for a _openrouter_model directive. Read-only.

query.description: Part of a model name or ID.

languageModelTools.name: litellm_set_setting
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Change one litellm-vscode-chat setting by its name without the litellm-vscode-chat. prefix (for example chat.timeout or consultTool.model); value null removes the configured value from the highest scope that sets it (the workspace value if one exists, else the user value), which is how the dashboard's Reset works. The extension validates the value exactly as the dashboard does and answers with a refusal you can correct. Not for servers (use litellm_save_server) or models.capabilities and models.parameters (use litellm_edit_model_records). The user confirms the change first.

setting.description: The setting name without the litellm-vscode-chat. prefix.

value.description: The new value, in the setting's own shape; null removes the configured value.

languageModelTools.name: litellm_edit_model_records
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Edit one matcher key of models.capabilities (context_length, max_input_tokens, max_output_tokens, supports_vision, supports_function_calling, supports_reasoning, and any other model_info field) or models.parameters (temperature, max_tokens, reasoning_effort, and other request parameters): set fields, unset fields, or remove the key. The key is a raw model ID or a prefix pattern like gpt-5*. Without server, the record in the settings scope the dashboard edits changes; with server, that servers entry's own record changes. Read litellm_inspect_model first so you change the right source. The user confirms the change first.

key.description: A raw model ID or a prefix pattern such as gpt-5*.

set.description: Fields to set on the record.

unset.description: Field names to remove from the record.

server.description: A servers entry label, to edit that entry's own record instead of the global setting.

languageModelTools.name: litellm_save_server
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Add, edit, rename, or adopt a LiteLLM servers entry. On an edit, fields you omit keep their stored values. Secrets: say where a key goes with secrets.apiKey = { action: set, location: secure } and omit value; the user is asked to type it in a masked box. Include value only if the user's agentTools.secretValues setting allows it. A stored secret never follows a changed host: when you change baseUrl, set the key again or clear it. renameFrom renames an existing entry; adoptFrom (an external provider group's label and base URL from litellm_configuration) copies that group into the setting and accepts no other edit in the same call. The user confirms the change first.

anyOf.description: Adopt an external provider group (one not in the servers setting) into the setting under label. Nothing else can be changed in the same call; edit the entry afterwards.

label.description: The entry's label (its identity; the model picker groups models under it).
The external group's label, from litellm_configuration.

baseUrl.description: The external group's base URL, from litellm_configuration.

secretLocations.description: Where each copied secret is stored; default secure.

anyOf.description: Add or edit a servers entry. On an edit, omitted fields keep their stored values.

label.description: The entry's label (its identity; the model picker groups models under it).

baseUrl.description: The server's root URL, e.g. http://localhost:4000. Required for a new entry.

apiVersion.description: A string sets it, null clears it, absent keeps the stored value.

oauthTokenUrl.description: A string sets it, null clears it, absent keeps the stored value.

oauthClientId.description: A string sets it, null clears it, absent keeps the stored value.

oauthScopes.description: A string sets it, null clears it, absent keeps the stored value.

virtualKeyHeader.description: A string sets it, null clears it, absent keeps the stored value.

headers.description: Custom HTTP headers (plain text, not secrets).

declaredModels.description: Model IDs to serve even when the server cannot list them (discovery.declared).

expectedFailures.description: Discovery endpoints this server is expected to fail.

modelCapabilities.description: The entry's own models.capabilities record, whole.

modelParameters.description: The entry's own models.parameters record, whole.

budget.description: Manual usage budget in USD; null clears it.

mcp.description: MCP opt-in: true, { url }, or null to clear.

location.description: Where a set secret is stored.

value.description: Omit it: the user is asked to type the secret in a masked box. Allowed only when the user's agentTools.secretValues setting is on.

value.description: Omit it: the user is asked to type the secret in a masked box. Allowed only when the user's agentTools.secretValues setting is on.

value.description: Omit it: the user is asked to type the secret in a masked box. Allowed only when the user's agentTools.secretValues setting is on.

renameFrom.description: The current label of the entry to rename to label.

languageModelTools.name: litellm_remove_server
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Remove a LiteLLM servers entry by label; or, with action hide and baseUrl, hide an external provider group that is not in the setting; or with action unhide restore a hidden one. The user confirms first.

baseUrl.description: Required for hide; optional for unhide.

languageModelTools.name: litellm_run_action
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Run one LiteLLM maintenance action: testConnection probes a STORED servers entry (label) with its stored credentials; testFeatureModel sends a feature's picked model (feature) a fixed probe; syncModels re-discovers every server's models; refreshCatalog refreshes the OpenRouter catalog; refreshUsage re-polls spend and budgets. The user confirms first.

label.description: The stored servers entry to probe with its stored credentials.

feature.description: The feature whose picked model receives a fixed probe prompt (a billable model request).

scripts.vscode:prepublish: tsc -p tsconfig.prod.json && bun scripts/dev/fetch-openrouter-catalog.ts && bun run bundle
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p ./ && tsc --noEmit -p src/webview && tsc --noEmit -p src/test/bun && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.scripts.json
scripts.test:host: bun run test:bun && bun run test:vscode
scripts.test:vscode: bun run compile && bun run bundle:dev && vscode-test --label unit --label activation-production --label host-fidelity --label host-fidelity-groups
scripts.test:coverage: bun test --coverage --coverage-reporter=lcov --coverage-dir=coverage/bun && bun run test:vscode --coverage && bun scripts/ci/check-coverage.ts
